description: This file defines a class QwenCodeHandler that manages OAuth authentication, token refresh, and communication with the Qwen AI API, including streaming chat completions and prompt completion.

classes.name: QwenCodeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles OAuth authentication, token management, and streaming chat completion requests to the Qwen AI API, extending BaseProvider and implementing SingleCompletionHandler.

methods.name: ensureClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAI client instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: loadCachedQwenCredentials
methods.description: Loads OAuth credentials from a cached file.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth access token, ensuring only one refresh occurs at a time.

methods.name: doRefreshAccessToken
methods.description: Performs the actual token refresh request to the OAuth endpoint.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the current OAuth token is still valid based on expiry time.

methods.name: ensureAuthenticated
methods.description: Ensures the OAuth token is valid, refreshing it if necessary, and updates the API client.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for API requests based on credentials.

methods.name: callApiWithRetry
methods.description: Calls an API method, retrying after token refresh if a 401 Unauthorized error occurs.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat message with the Qwen API, handling streaming responses and special blocks.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model ID and info used for API requests.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt to the API and returns the completion as a string.
